lines.text: [upbeat] Bring your company record into the AI tools you already use.
Acme Record keeps every filing, release and deck current, and hands each one to Claude and ChatGPT with its source.
Ask for a check, and every figure in your draft is set against what you filed.
[upbeat] Catch the figure that doesn't match before anyone else does: Acme Record checks your deck against the filed release and fixes it in one click.
[upbeat] Search your own record for a figure, and Acme Record shows every document that states it, checked against the filed release, with one press to fix the one that's wrong.
[upbeat] Start the morning with the one check that needs you: the figure that differs, the release that settles it, and the fix, all before the call.
